label: grants channel access
type: the headline predicate of the Sync Gateway cross-product-family round - 15 occurrences across 8 files, by far the most-recurring minted predicate in this batch
domain_note: subject = a user or role; object = sgw:channel. The whole point: server/'s requiresPrivilege (an operation-gated check) does not generalize to this shape at all - Sync Gateway inverts the direction entirely (documents are tagged with channels; access is granted by channel membership; reads are a pure set-intersection with no per-operation gate).
